    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Admin
    Represents an administrator in the library system.
    AuthService
    Handles authentication and session management for admins, librarians, and users.
    Book
    Represents a book in the library system.
    BookFineStrategy
    A fine calculation strategy for books.
    BookService
    Provides operations for managing books in the library system.
    BorrowingService
    Handles borrowing operations for users.
    CDFineStrategy
    A fine calculation strategy for CDs.
    ConsoleMenu
    Console-based menu interface for the library management system.
    EmailMessage
    Represents an email message used by the library notification system.
    EmailService
    Service responsible for sending email notifications using SMTP.
    EmailTestMain
    A simple test class used to verify that the EmailService is working correctly by sending a real email.
    FileStorage
    Handles all file-based persistence for the library system.
    Fine
    Represents a fine issued to a user for overdue library items.
    FineCalculator
    Calculates fines for different media types using a strategy pattern.
    FineService
    Service responsible for managing fines within the library system.
    FineStrategy
    Represents a strategy for calculating fines for overdue library items.
    Librarian
    Represents a librarian in the library system.
    Loan
    Represents a loan record for a borrowed library item.
    LoanService
    Service responsible for managing the borrowing, returning, and tracking of book and CD loans in the library system.
    Main
    Entry point of the Library Management System application.
    MediaType
    Represents the type of media that can be borrowed in the library system.
    ReminderService
    Service responsible for sending reminder emails to users who have overdue loans.
    User
    Represents a generic user in the library system.
    UserService
    Service responsible for managing user accounts in the library system.
